content.text: {"headline":"Approve P3: outage message, chat deflection, break delay and overtime for 25 general agents. It lifts service level to 84.3% for 11:15-13:15 at ₹5,796.","why":"The general queue surge is driven by login_issue calls (98 vs 36.1 expected), which matches open P2 incident INC-20261024-1535, where net banking and app login are returning HTTP 503 errors. With no action, the disruption window is predicted at 48.3% service level and 12.3% abandons, with general at 27.3%. P3 tells login callers about the outage, deflects 20% of balance enquiries to chat, delays general breaks between 11:15 and 12:00, and adds 25 overtime agents from 11:45 to 13:00. That brings general to 81.8%, payments to 86.8% and abandons to 4.0%, all within policy. It is the cheapest option that reaches the 80% target.","trade_offs":["P1 (no cost) and P2 (₹396) protect budget but miss the target, predicting 49.8% and 65.0%. P1 also lowers payments from 72.0% to 68.1%.","P4 costs ₹8,496 (₹2,700 more than P3) for only a small gain: 86.0% vs 84.3% service level and 3.1% vs 4.0% abandons.","P3 improves payments as well (86.8% vs 72.0% with no action), so it adds no risk to the other queue.","Overtime only starts at 11:45, so 11:15-11:45 will still be weak. Rest of day is predicted at 91.2%."],"watch":"Check overtime uptake reaches 25 agents by 11:45. Track login_issue volume and the incident status, and stand down overtime early if the certificate fix lands. Other call reasons are also running about 1.4x normal, so re-check if general service level stays below 80% after 12:00."}
